svg.title: Tablemates conceptual ER diagram
svg.desc: Eight entity sets, eleven relationships and two many-to-many junction mappings. Rectangles are entities, diamonds relationships, ellipses attributes, underlines keys. Thick arrows from entities to relationships mean exactly one; thin arrows mean at most one.

g.text: Current implementation: 8 entity sets + 2 M:N relationship tables
Notation — read each connector from its entity toward the relationship
Underlined attribute = chosen key. Dashed ellipse = derived value, not a stored restaurant field.
Saves maps to favorite; ClassifiedAs maps to restaurant_cuisine. Other foreign keys are represented by relationships.
